title: Sigrún's three days
disclaimer: Fictional simulation. Sigrún, every company, statement and statistic here is invented.

shots.narration: This is Sigrún, in Grindavik. At three in the morning, she was packing for a flight.

notification.author: ThriftJet Air
notification.text: Our new VolcanoFlex™ fare lets you change your flight whenever the volcano changes its mind. Terms and conditions apply.

shots.narration: Then the ground opened outside town. Her airline already had a new fare.

notification.author: ThriftJet Air
notification.text: ThriftJet now offers Evacuation Class: same seat, louder announcements. Bags extra.

shots.narration: Sigrún evacuated in an orderly queue, according to the brochure.

notification.author: Synergexa
notification.text: Introducing CandleBox™ Premium: the outage-ready subscription. Now three times the price.

shots.narration: At the shelter, the power went out. Her phone suggested a subscription.

notification.author: Synergexa
notification.text: Synergexa shares are up 4% after we announced we are 'monitoring the situation'.

shots.narration: By evening, every flight was grounded. Including hers.

notification.author: Committee for Global Stability (Interim)
notification.text: We warmly welcome the aid from Norway and have formed a working group to decide where to put it.

shots.narration: Day two: help from Norway, and a six-hundred-page customs form.

notification.author: Brandwell Inc.
notification.text: We apologise for any inconvenience the crisis caused. The crisis was not us. Use code BACK20.

shots.narration: Day three: the power came back. Her flight did not.
